excerpt: Our Year 10 and Year 11 Tournament of Minds teams represented Rosehill College at the NZ National Finals in Wellington, receiving Honours and Merit respectively.
title: Tournament of Minds National Finals | Wellington
body:
An outstanding weekend for Rosehill College at the **Tournament of Minds NZ National Finals** in Wellington, with both of our competing teams receiving national recognition.

Our **Year 10 team received Honours**, while our **Year 11 team received Merit** for their performances on the national stage.

Tournament of Minds (TOM) challenges students to work collaboratively under pressure, using creativity, critical thinking and problem-solving to develop and present solutions to a panel of judges.

Reaching the National Finals was already a significant achievement after a fantastic showing at the Auckland Regional Finals. We are very proud of the way our ākonga represented Rosehill College in Wellington.

A special thank you to **NZST** for their support in making this opportunity possible for our students.

Congratulations to all our students, teachers and supporters involved. A great result for Rosehill College! 🌹
